import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        long x = sc.nextLong();
        long y = sc.nextLong();
        long n = sc.nextLong();

        long bestNum = 1L << 32;
        long bestDen = 1L << 32;
        long bestErr = 1L << 32;

        for (long b = 1; b <= n; ++b) {
            long a = Math.max(x * b / y - 10, 0L);
            for (long j = 0; j < 20; ++j) {
                long num = a + j;
                long err = Math.abs(x * b - num * y);
                
                if (bestErr * b > err * bestDen ||
                    (bestErr * b == err * bestDen && 
                     (bestDen > b || (bestDen == b && bestNum > num)))) {
                    bestErr = err;
                    bestNum = num;
                    bestDen = b;
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(bestNum + "/" + bestDen);
        sc.close();
    }
}
